title: MartinezPeon2024: Kinesthetic motor imagery at graded force levels
description: EEG recordings of kinesthetic motor imagery of a right-hand ball squeeze at three graded force levels (10%, 40%, and 70% of maximal voluntary contraction) from 10 healthy participants. Data were acquired with a 14-channel Emotiv EPOC headset at 128 Hz, with five 5-s imagery cues per 40-s recording and two recordings per force level per subject. This BIDS release was produced via MOABB and supports research on force-level characterization and classification for brain-computer interfaces.
methods_description: Participants performed cue-based, offline kinesthetic motor imagery of a right-hand ball squeeze at 10, 40, and 70% MVC. Each 40 s recording contained five cues (at 2.9, 10.9, 18.9, 26.9, and 34.9 s, 5 s each), and each force level was recorded twice per subject. EEG was recorded with a 14-channel wet saline Emotiv EPOC system at 128 Hz, referenced to P3/P4.
